items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I don't know him. No, he got that, true of his, Vorice, which he used to play first trumpet at the Offsen Theatre

ctx.x: Remember any method book that he used?

Well, yeah, he bought, you know, the first book he bought me was a French Pocharon book. I don't know him. No, he got that, true of his, Vorice, which he used to play first trumpet at the Offsen Theatre, I believe his brother would say that. Yeah, true of his brother. Well, see, they were very good friends. He got the book for him. And after I finished that book, then he got me one of these Auburn Methods. Oh, yeah. I remember that. That's the book he brought me through, the Auburn Method. And then when I went…
I appreciate you telling me that. I wasn't right to interrupt you. Yeah. I wanted to find out more about the lessons. How often did you go there?
